entry.summary: A visitor visa is needed before travel. Applicants from Australia need a sponsorship letter signed by a Nauruan citizen living in Nauru.
entry.pre_arrival: Apply to the Principal Immigration Officer (Department of Justice and Border Control) or a Nauruan mission.
entry.other: Fees under the Immigration Regulations 2014 were A$50, A$150 and A$250 for one, two and three months; confirm current fees.
entry.next_check: Confirm the current form, fee and whether a visa on arrival exists with the Nauru Consulate-General in Brisbane.
